title: Bee Removal in Jericho, Long Island
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, and yellow jacket nest removal in Jericho, Long Island. Wall void and structural nest treatment by licensed technicians. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides expert wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nest removal throughout Jericho, Long Island. Our licensed technicians locate and treat nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, eaves, and structural wood — eliminating colonies that defend aggressively and won't leave on their own. Fast, effective solutions tailored to Jericho's residential and commercial properties.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC brings over a decade of experience serving Jericho and surrounding Long Island communities with safe, effective bee removal services. Our certified technicians use industry-leading techniques and equipment to ensure complete hive removal while minimizing risk to your property and family.
localContext: Jericho's tree-lined neighborhoods and proximity to parks like Cantiague Park create ideal nesting sites for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets in chimneys, wall voids, attic spaces, and soffit gaps. From the historic homes near the Jericho Cider Mill to modern properties along Jericho Turnpike, our team understands the unique stinging-insect pressure in this established Long Island community — and the structural access challenges that come with older construction.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Jericho?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest in Jericho?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service throughout Jericho and Long Island. Most wasp, hornet, and yellow jacket nest treatments are completed within 2–4 hours, though nests deep inside wall voids or attics may require additional access time.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Jericho?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Will wasps or hornets return after nest removal?
faqs.answer: Our service includes nest treatment, removal of accessible nest material, and sealing of every entry point to prevent recolonization. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
